prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O Filho do homem não veio para ser servido, mas para servir.

meta.face: A sturdy man of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a full, round face — soft, low cheekbones, a long, slender, straight nose, small almond-shaped dark eyes turned slightly up at the outer corners under thick, straight dark brows, a small rounded chin and a small mouth in a warm, quiet smile; a thick crown of short greying dark hair around the Franciscan tonsure, and a kindly gaze.
meta.basis: The portrait by an unidentified painter, c. 1850 (Commons), shows a clean-shaven friar with a full round face, a thick ring of dark hair and a slight smile, in a dark habit with a white cord; aged to about sixty, when he was building the Mosteiro da Luz and began giving the pills.
